<reason>PRO won by mapping CON’s own concessions—dumping may stay a priced business cost, and stores may skip a last offer when recovery looks unlikely—onto the motion’s test of waste as overhead. CON’s timing fork and fee alternative were the sharper mechanism critique, but they never showed why unattempted industrial dumping should remain Plan A, while PRO kept donate-or-discount as a live, narrower duty.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO’s R2 distinction that a fee buys permission to destroy while a real markdown buys an attempted recovery, then locking CON’s “skip the last offer” answer as restoring the dumpster default.</best_rebuttal>
